response.overview: In Between Dreams is an intimate autobiographical documentary following a filmmaker from Kolkata as he wanders through Paris, searching for memories of his childhood and home. One day, he lands in Parc des Buttes-Chaumont where he encounters strangers gathered in music and conversation. As they speak of dreams, language, and memory, the park becomes a living crossroads of migration and longing. In communicating their dreams and memories to one another, they create a fragile but powerful sense of a shared belonging. And in that exchange, the filmmaker too finds what he had been searching for, a familiar feeling that he could call his home.
response.tagline: A filmmaker retraces the thread of childhood wonders, crossing places and faces, collecting dreams, languages and memories, only to discover fragments of himself.
response.title: In between dreams
